statute_note: Principal source: LankaLaw's consolidated PDF data/legal-sources/library/statutes/19-1931-buddhist-temporalities-ordinance.pdf (28 pp, text layer; registry preferred_source_url), parsed with parse_consolidated_pdf.py into 44 sections; the accepted tree is byte-identical to the canonical parse before this pass's hand edits. Other sources inspected: the LankaLaw HTML edition (same chain header, no subscription banner) as verification source; title pages of the four Government Printer scans (11/1968, 22/1980, 18/1981, 42/1981) and of the Administrative Districts Act 22 of 1955; LankaLaw HTML of 11/1968, 34/1973, 22/1980, 18/1981, 42/1981 and 3/1992 (none carries the banner); the Government Printer PDF of Act 34 of 2013 in full. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 3 of 1992 (chain header of both editions). The file's '2024' label is the republisher's compilation date; the earlier note that called this a '2024 consolidated PDF' is corrected. Review performed: earlier 5-lens subagent review, 3 rounds, converged; this pass re-read the chain header, s.2 definitions and every node touched by the 2013 substitution. Amendment coverage: 11 reconciliation rows. Ten instruments are in the chain header and already incorporated; Act No. 34 of 2013 post-dates the baseline and was applied from its own text: 68 expression substitutions outside s.2, one definition inserted, one repealed, with the pre-amendment wording kept on each node; nothing applied twice. Structural weaknesses: the Schedule (Forms A and B, declaration forms under s.41) is deliberately not extracted and is recorded in omitted_provisions; 17 sections keep their full text alongside their first child (parser convention). Missing sources: Ordinances 9 of 1940, 14 of 1941, 32 of 1947; no Government Printer copy of the principal Ordinance. Unresolved: the Schedule forms' current text after 2013; whether any post-1992 instrument other than Act 34 of 2013 exists. Registry: title 'Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance' agrees with s.1; curriculum lists 22/1980, 18/1981, 42/1981, 3/1992 and 34/2013, all reconciled. Lawyer verification: unverified. Pipeline status needs_structural_review because the Schedule bodies are not in the tree and the 2013 substitution was applied by pipeline across 68 nodes without a post-2013 consolidated text to check against.

The HTML edition prints the same chain. The file's '2024' label is the republisher's compilation date, not a cutoff.

source_conflicts: PDF metadata and the registry call the file 'Consolidated (2024)'; its printed chain header stops at Act No. 3 of 1992 and Act No. 34 of 2013 is not reflected in it. The earlier package note describing a '2024 LankaLaw consolidated PDF' as if that were the cutoff is corrected here.
Act No. 34 of 2013, s.3(a), spells the term 'bhikku'; both editions of the Ordinance spell it 'bhikkhu'. Insertion placed after the 'bhikkhu' definition.
Both editions print 'upasampcida' in the 'bhikkhu' definition (for 'upasampada'); kept as printed.
